FIELDS.NAME: Parcel Point Shipping Center
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Parcel Point Shipping Center is a full-service post office and shipping center located in Springfield, IL. We specialize in offering a range of shipping options through established partnerships with major carriers, including USPS, UPS, and FedEx. Our operations include package acceptance, shipping, and the provision of mailing supplies to both retail and business customers. We emphasize convenience with self-service kiosks, ensuring that our customers can easily manage their shipments at their own pace. 

Our team is rigorously trained in customer service and shipping procedures, enabling us to handle a variety of packages while adhering to compliance standards regarding prohibited items and hazardous materials. Security is a priority at our facility, where we maintain surveillance systems and secure storage for packages. With a focus on operational efficiency, we regularly update our inventory management systems to ensure we meet customer demands without disruption.

We take pride in our commitment to customer satisfaction, ensuring that all operations are conducted within legal frameworks and industry standards. Our goal is to provide a reliable and efficient shipping experience, helping our customers navigate both domestic and limited international shipping needs effectively.
